# The CIS-Dragnet Benchmark Study

> State of Stockbroking Operations and Investor Experience in Nigeria: A 2026 CIS-Dragnet Study. A study by The Chartered Institute of Stockbrokers (CIS), delivered with Dragnet Solutions Limited. It measures how Nigeria's stockbroking firms operate and how their investors experience them, side by side.

## Key facts
- Formal title: State of Stockbroking Operations and Investor Experience in Nigeria: A 2026 CIS-Dragnet Study
- Short name: The CIS-Dragnet Benchmark Study
- Survey opens: Monday 9 November 2026
- Survey closes: Friday 11 December 2026
- Results: will be published after the survey closes
- Who takes part: stockbroking firms (each firm's coordinator receives a personal invitation from the CIS-Dragnet Benchmark Study and names the MD or CEO, Head of Compliance and Head of Operations); individual investors, Nigerian institutional investors and institutional investors abroad, from 9 November 2026 through the link their stockbroking firm sends them; and six market institutions by invitation (SEC, NGX, CSCS, FMDQ, NASD, LCFE)
- Outputs: a public Industry report; an Institutional Perspectives section; a private Firm report for each participating firm
- Confidentiality: answers are reported only in aggregate; results are reported with the number of responses behind them; where only a very small number of institutions respond, their figures are withheld so no one can be identified; firms never see investors' or colleagues' answers; no firm receives another named firm's results
- Contact: support@cisdragnetstudy.com
